programme.desc: Blaze brings all of his monster truck pals to VelocityVille for a wild race to the top of Eagle Rock! But Crusher will stop at nothing to beat race car Blaze and friends, setting traps to slow them down.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Swoops the helicopter loses his rotor, and without it he can’t fly! It’s time for Blaze and AJ to retrieve the runaway rotor, adventuring up onto The Sky Track, an amazing course that weaves through the clouds.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ, and Stripes are searching for the Wishing Wheel: a magical treasure that will grant a wish for one lucky race car. But with chomping, stomping, and slithering dangers at every turn, can Blaze and his friends stay on track?

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze visits VelocityVille to compete with his new racecar pals in the longest race ever: the Hundred Mile Race! But Crusher is racing too, and he’ll do anything to win.

programme.desc: Woody's gripped with fear of losing Kelly when she returns with a Frenchman.

programme.desc: Sam inadvertently leaves a message on Rebecca's machine that he loves her.

programme.desc: Sam injures his back while on his annual Valentine's Day date with his old flame.

programme.desc: Woody increases traffic at Cheers by selling his famous chili.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Cliff poses as a judge in the Miss Barmaid contest to win Carla's favor.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam plans to strike out an old baseball rival at a charity game.

programme.desc: Sam locks himself out of the house while babysitting for Lilith and Frasier's son.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam embarks on a search for a suitable mother to have his baby.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and Rebecca seek psychiatric help for getting in the mood.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Carla's psychic asks her to take over her spiritual reading business.

programme.desc: Woody takes a second job at a graveyard to pay for Kelly's engagement ring.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Carla acts like a holy terror when her son decides to join the priesthood.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Frasier has a run-in with his first wife while at a children's concert with his family.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle pense que sa mère a une liaison avec un livreur UPS. Lorsque la méfiance du public tombe sur lui, la livraison de colis dans le quartier est menacée, et Eric Cartman achète un système de sécurité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Quand Butters sort de l'école, ses parents se rendent compte qu'il est temps de lui dire pourquoi il n'est pas comme tous les autres enfants. Il doit se rendre dans un lieu étrange pour apprendre les voies de son peuple.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de Randy pour Halloween empêchent Stan de pouvoir aller à la chasse aux bonbons avec ses amis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ayant appris que Jésus s'était dopé pour accomplir ses miracles, le monde se sent perdu et trahi. Les garçons, joints par le reste de la nation, retirent les bracelets jaunes symbolisant leur ancienne idole.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman cache un terrible secret dans sa chambre à coucher qui pourrait changer les élections présidentielles 2012 aux États-unis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle est en colère contre Cartman qui a pris la mauvaise habitude de parler au téléphone avec le haut-parleur, et l'accuse de se mêler de sa vie privée. Cartman informe alors les autres élèves de l'école que le gouvernement les espionne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Peter Mullen informe ses camarades de classe que ses parents (entre autres !) regardent 'Informative Murder Porn', une émission susceptible de les inciter à s'entretuer. Les enfants décident donc de bloquer les chaines.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a appris que George Zimmerman n'était pas coupable du meurtre de Trayvon Martin, un jeune noir dans un quartier résidentiel aux Etats-Unis, Cartman est perturbé par une personne qu'il considère comme une menace pour l'humanité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Henrietta, une des gothiques de l'école, est envoyée dans un camp pour enfants en difficulté. Elle en revient transformée en emo. En l'apercevant, les autres gothiques vont paniquer et demander de l'aide aux vampires.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Monsieur Mackey annonce aux élèves de South Park que l'école est maintenant dotée d'un nouveau système informatique : "Intellilink". En essayant d'en faire une démonstration, il s'avère que celui-ci ne fonctionne pas comme prévu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de la plus grosse journée de shopping de l'année ont commencé. L'hiver approche et cela ne peut signifier qu'une seule chose : la lutte pour être le premier à entrer dans le centre commercial le fameux "Vendredi noir" est lancée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le black friday approche, les armées des clans de Cartman et Kenny vont s'affronter dans un bain de sang, l'enjeu : les nouvelles consoles de jeu vidéo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet épisode est la bataille final entre les pro X-BOX one et PS4, les deux clans plmus que jamais divisés vont se battre jusqu'au bout pour défendre leur console préférée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les enfants de South Park découvre Photoshop et son pouvoir d'amélioration physique. Et Wendy va tout faire pour montrer aux garçons que ce n'est pas la vérité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Afin de ne plus être obligés d'aller à l'école ou de faire quoi que ce soit, Stan, Kyle, Cartman, Kenny et Butters décident de créer leur startup en utilisant Kickstarter pour la financer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: M. Mackey agace tout le monde à propos de son régime alimentaire sans gluten. Après avoir été témoins des risques liés au gluten, les habitants changent radicalement leur comportement alimentaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dans le but d'utiliser les toilettes des filles pour échapper aux toilettes bondés des garçons, Cartman annonce qu'il est transgenre. Pendant ce temps, Randy se démène avec sa double identité de Lorde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le nouveau service de transport de Timmy destiné à recueillir des fonds pour le camp d'été lui fait beaucoup d'ennemis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman découvre les drônes et en profite pour filmer l'intimité des habitants de South Park. Ce qui va entraîner une paranoïa autour de l'utilisation des drônes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan devient accro au nouveau jeu sur mobile produit par le Canada, mettant en scène Terrance et Philippe. L'application est dite 'gratuite' mais propose de dépenser de l'argent pour progresser dans le jeu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman a acheté l'Oculus Rift et les enfants ne savent plus s'ils sont dans le monde réel ou dans le monde virtuel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny excelle dans le jeu de carte Magic : l'assemblée ou les combats de coqs font rage dans les milieux underground. Randy, pensant qu'il s'agit de tout autre chose mais se trompe.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ike ne veut plus jouer avec Kyle à Call of Duty et préfère regarder des personnes jouant et commentant le jeu sur YouTube

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les hologrammes de stars décédées envahissent la télévision : le monde court à la catastrophe dont il ne pourrait jamais se relever.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les garçons expriment tout le respect qu'ils ont pour Caitlyn Jenner dans cette épisode de la série South Park, plus magnifique et courageuse que jamais.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: M. Garrison veut construire un mur pour tenir à distance les immigrants sans papiers.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ville de South Park entreprend d'importantes rénovations. De son côté, Kenny pense qu'il est temps pour lui de chercher un travail.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman est persuadé d'être le meilleur critique gastronomique du net que South Park ait connu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se fait humilier sur les réseaux sociaux à cause de son poids.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les élèves asiatiques de l'école représentent en peinture l'amour imaginaire entre Tweek et Craig.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park ne veulent plus de policiers dans leur ville.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy, le rédacteur en chef du journal de l'école, se heurte à l'opinion un peu obtue de Principal PC.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Principal PC disparaît avec deux élèves de CM1.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle mène son combat aux côtés d'une alliée dangereuse au détriment de son amitié avec Stan.
programme.sub-title: Le jugement final de Principal PC

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La poire à lavement devance le sandwich au caca dans la course à la présidence, et cela ne l'arrange pas. J.J. Abrams a pour mission de faire un reboot de l'hymne américain et Kyle veut démasquer le troll qui harcèle les filles de l'école

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le troll chasseauxgarces42 sévit toujours. Les filles sont de plus en plus remontées et menacent les garçons de répliquer si le harcèlement continue. Ceux-ci sont persuadés que Cartman est responsable et ils comptent bien l'arrêter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tous deux privés de technologie, Cartman et Heidi se lient d'amitié. La guerre est ouverte entre Freja Ollegard et chasseauxgarces42 qui a peur d'être découvert. M. Garrison fait tout pour ne pas être élu président.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kyros, unbowed by Diamante's vicious attacks, fights back with the anger and retribution of all of Dressrosa in order to fulfill his promise to protect Rebecca. If he is successful, only a few executives will remain.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Pica loses his temper and turns his full wrath against King Riku, whom he hopes to destroy, ending the revolution against Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Zoro, who has been distracted by Pica and drawn far from the battle, has to hatch a plan to save the king!
programme.sub-title: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others on the old King's Plateau in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica's near-unstoppable onslaught. Meanwhile, King Riku ponders what it means to be a good king.
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro finishes off Pica, and those below his crumbling body rush to find shelter. Meanwhile, the Tontattas finish up demolishing the SMILE Factory, and Luffy's hand is forced in his duel with Bellamy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law's lifeless body! Meanwhile, Doflamingo takes the next step to end the game he started, which will endanger everybody in Dressrosa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Birdcage draws tighter and tighter around Dressrosa, threatening to destroy all life on the island kingdom! Meanwhile, Doflamingo stands down Luffy for a final confrontation, but a surprising twist shocks everyone on the top of the Royal Palace!
programme.sub-title: A Blade of Tenacity! The Gamma Knife Counterattack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law's attack proves powerful - but Doflamingo's power has depths which he and Luffy haven't bargained for. When Doflamingo makes his counterattack, Luffy stares him down with an amazing power.
programme.sub-title: A Collision of Haki! Luffy vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Trebol's wrath is fully inflamed as Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo's game. But Law gathers enough energy to do more than just speak out.
programme.sub-title: Unassailable! The Stunning Secret of Trebol!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Cavendish has to make a difficult decision when the severely wounded Law begs him to be left behind. Meanwhile, seeing even his Second Gear or Third Gear attacks aren't working against Doflamingo, Luffy decides to use his ultimate technique!
programme.sub-title: Anger Erupts! I Will Take Everything upon Myself!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Doflamingo duke it out while the Birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa! Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country, while Luffy's Fourth Gear proves quite potent against Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Birdcage continues its merciless constriction, sending the residents of Dressrosa fleeing towards the center of the island, while King Riku calls out to his people: Survive long enough for Luffy to vanquish the last of the royal family.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fourth Gear gives Luffy the power he needs to head off Doflamingo at every strike! But the energy required to keep Fourth Gear going starts to take a toll on Luffy. Will he have enough left to finish the job?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bounce-man's power has drained Luffy, leaving him in need of a rest before he can reuse his Haki, but luckily the gladiators from the Colosseum have come around and are focusing on taking down Doflamingo! Sabo steps in at a crucial moment.
programme.sub-title: Flame Dragon King! Protect Luffy's Life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Luffy and so many of the Straw Hats' allies incapacitated, victory seems inevitable for Doflamingo - but the compassion of Mansherry may be enough to turn the tide and renew their hope - to stop the Birdcage!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts towards slowing down the Birdcage as it squeezes the life out of the country! Meanwhile, Viola seeks Doflamingo out herself, for a shocking confrontation!
programme.sub-title: As Long as We Breathe! Stop the Deadly Birdcage!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Only a bit more time remains before Luffy returns to the scene! But as time slips by, those who had been roused by Princess Mansherry's powers begin to falter! Meanwhile, Rebecca, under the control of Doflamingo, is about to attack Viola!
programme.sub-title: Dead or Alive! A Fateful Countdown!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy regains enough Haki to face off against Doflamingo, but his health is still poor. With the Birdcage closing in, is there a technique left in his repertoire that is strong enough to take down Doflamingo?
programme.sub-title: Attack on a Celestial! Luffy's King Kong Gun of Anger!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Doflamingo thoroughly quashed and the Birdcage collapsing, the people of Dressrosa shed tears of joy remembering the hardships they've endured, and the actions taken by Luffy and the others to free them.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jesus Burgess of the Blackbeard Pirates tries to agitate Sabo, mocking Ace's final words in order to unsettle him enough that he can try to steal the Flare-Flare Fruit! Meanwhile, people of Dressrosa beg King Riku to resume the crown.
programme.sub-title: The Unheard-of! Admiral Fujitora’s Surprising Decision!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Repercussions of Doflamingo's defeat reverberate around the world! Fujitora's actions put the Navy in a tight spot, and the "Worst Generation" beings to stir into action!
programme.sub-title: Sending a Shock Wave! The Worst Generation Goes Into Action!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The combatants in the battle for Dressrosa can finally begin to recoup, but those who stay awake are treated to the story of how Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army!
programme.sub-title: The Birth of the Legend! The Adventures of the Revolutionary Warrior Sabo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sabo recounts his surprising reunion with Luffy at the Colosseum as the Straw Hats and the others continue to recoup. Meanwhile, Fujitora gambles on how to make his next move - and the odds are in Luffy's favor!
programme.sub-title: The Brothers' Bond! The Untold Story Behind Luffy and Sabo's Reunion!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As Sabo departs, our attention shifts to the other Straw Hats waging a fierce battle on a mysterious island. And a new drama is set into motion as ill portents fall from the sky!
programme.sub-title: The Strongest Creature! One of the Four Emperors - Kaido, King of the Beasts!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As Luffy and the others begin to come to their senses, major players in the Navy arrive to search Dressrosa for the Straw Hats! Also, Rebecca's history is whitewashed with a fake cover story - but why?
programme.sub-title: Fujitora Takes Action! The Complete Siege of the Straw Hats!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fujitora's flirting with chance has turned out poorly for the Straw Hats as the full Navy force bears down on Dressrosa searching for the pirates! Luffy and the others make a mad dash for the east port to get off the island.
programme.sub-title: A State of Emergency! Rebecca Is Kidnapped!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Rebecca has precious little time to follow Luffy's lead and make it to Kyros. Can she make it in time? Meanwhile, Fujitora is closing in on Bartolomeo and the other Colosseum warriors while Trafalgar Law faces the shadows of his past!
programme.sub-title: The Bond Between Father and Daughter! Kyros and Rebecca!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law and Sengoku share memories of Corazon, and the secret of Trafalgar Law's name. Meanwhile, Fujitora uses the destruction caused by the battle in Dressrosa as a weapon, and squares off one-on-one with Luffy!
programme.sub-title: Men's Pride! Luffy vs. Fujitora, Head-to-Head!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The people of Dressrosa show their appreciation to the Straw Hats one last time by foiling Fujitora's strategy. As Luffy and the others are able to finally make their break from the island, however, an unbelievable new chapter opens in the story.
programme.sub-title: No Way Out! Admiral Fujitora's Ruthless Pursuit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With newfound allies won in the battle at Dressrosa, and as the Navy watches, Luffy and the Straw Hats depart Dressrosa for open water. But will Luffy accept the oath of allegiance given by his new fleet?
programme.sub-title: Sons' Cups! The Straw Hat Fleet is Formed!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the Straw Hats are underway, Doflamingo has serious predictions for the upset of the world order! Meanwhile, the recent actions in Dressrosa have led to surprising results!
programme.sub-title: The Numerous Rivals Struggle Amongst Themselves! The Raging Monsters of the New World

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While heading to the next island, Zou, Luffy's appetite causes them trouble and he and Bartolomeo find themselves entangled in the scheme of a pirate lord who can manipulate silver.
programme.sub-title: The Silver Fortress! Luffy and Barto's Great Adventure!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Tram-Man arrives! And has Luffy, Bartolomeo and Desire on the run! The deeper the three fall into the pit, however, the more clear it becomes that Bill's group hides a terrible secret!
programme.sub-title: An Underground Maze! Luffy vs. the Tram Human!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Bartolomeo, and Desire make their way up the mineshaft, but Bill's assassin, Peseta, has other plans! Just when the going gets tough, help arrives, and Zoro battles the assassin head on!
programme.sub-title: The Sword Technique Heats Up! Law and Zoro Finally Appear!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Desire, and Bartolomeo go up against Bill! But the mad, Smelt-Smelt man becomes deranged and lets his true power unfurl! Do Luffy and the others have any hope of exposing Bill's self-serving aims and turning his gang against him?
programme.sub-title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Fights a Battle in Extreme Heat!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack: Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the Library. Can they reach the Library before it closes?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bugga Bugga: Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Fish Out of Water: Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Little Star: Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Prince: Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken: Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off on an educational adventure to meet him.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: El Coqui: In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Stuck Truck: Calling all trucks! Boots sure loves trucks. When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue. Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Louder!: What are we going to do? Cockledoodledoo! Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun. Along the way we practice making lots of noise.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Roberto The Robot: Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Potato: Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Journey To The Purple Planet: Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Lost City: Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Meet Diego!: Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Save The Puppies: Woof! Woof! Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies." A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages. To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ¡Por Favor!: Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou - a cute and cuddly forest creature - who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Dino: Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island. It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs. Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' Special Day: Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots most favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: To The South Pole: Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin! It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Pingüino all the way back home to the South Pole.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boot's Cuddly Dinosaur: It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: I Love Lucy

programme.title: I Love Lucy

programme.title: I Love Lucy

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao’s Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn’t a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North, Part 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Zhao’s invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe’s defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan. Aang goes to the spirit world for help – but will he return in time to stop Zhao and prevent the destruction of the Water Tribe?
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North, Part 2

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: On their way to Omashu, the kids become lost in the treacherous "Cave of Two Lovers."

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang enters Omashu so he can learn Earthbending from King Bumi, but the city is in the hands of the Fire Nation!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being "connected to the Earth" from an unlikely teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang must clear up a wave of anti-Avatar sentiment and atone for something he did in the past.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang discovers a possible Earthbending mentor at an underground tournament.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When the kids are prevented from taking the "easy way" into Ba Sing Se, they must escort a family of refugees there the hard way -- through the deadly Serpent's Pass.
programme.sub-title: The Journey To Ba Sing Se Part 1: The Serpent's Pass

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang discovers a colossal Fire Nation invention heading for Ba Sing Se, and the kids must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.
programme.sub-title: The Journey To Ba Sing Se Part 2: The Drill

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A guru at the Eastern Air Temple helps Aang take the next step in his Avatar journey.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister conquest of Ba Sing Se.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po is asked to bring a young princess to the King of the Qidan to make a peace offering, they learn that an agreement between the two kingdoms will come at a cost.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: After the Croc Bandits steal Shifu's favorite ruby-encrusted statue of Oogway from Po and Tigress, the two warriors must team up to get the statue back and return it home.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.desc: Gayle says her soon-to-be daughter-in-law, Hannah, is manipulative, immoral and disrespectful and she’s never even met her! Gayle claims Hannah's relationship with her son, Ryan, is based on sin. See what happens when Gayle and Hannah meet with Dr. Phil!
programme.sub-title: My Son Picked The Wrong Fiancee

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Test Results Revealed: Is 15-Year-Old Marie Really Pregnant Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Actress Lindsay Lohan's mom, Dina, has been accused of being a bad mom, to riding the coattails of her daughter. Dina sets the record straight & reveals details inside her marriage to Michael. Plus, meet a woman who says Michael is her child's father.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Inside the “California House of Horrors” where 13 children were starved, chained and abused by their own parents. Family, neighbors and childhood friends speak about the tragedy. Cleveland kidnap survivor Michelle Knight sends a message to the children.
programme.sub-title: Inside The California House Of Horror: 13 Children Rescued After Being Shackled And Abused

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two survivors of abduction, Katie Beers and Sarah Maynard, share their stories in exclusive interviews with Dr. Phil. How did they survive their horrifying ordeals?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Learning your spouse is a cheater is devastating, but how do you recover when his lover is also your best friend? This young couple was newlyweds when she found him in bed with her best friend and bridesmaid. He says he loves both--can Dr. Phil help?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 18, says she is tired of her mom butting into her love life with boyfriend Eric. Mom Courtney says it's because Brooklyn's boyfriend has two children & a wife! Eric's wife, Mandy, wants Brooklyn to leave her husband alone & she'll fight for him.
programme.sub-title: My Boyfriend Is Married & His Wife Is Irrelvant To Me

programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Lies, Child Sex Abuse, And Stalking Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can a man introduce another woman into his marriage and form a healthy, "triangular" relationship, in which he is shared by his wife and his mistress? Part 1

programme.sub-title: Help! My Narcissist Ex Is Abusing My Children And Nobody Believes Me

programme.sub-title: Destoni's Drama: Will She Accept Help Pt. 2

programme.desc: Alethea feels trapped in a rage-filled relationship with her partner Kevin. She says "The Hulk," also known as "Kevin's anger," is so off the charts, even strangers call police. Kevin says his rage is a result of brain trauma. See MRI brain scan results.

programme.sub-title: My In-Laws Tried To Kill Me

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shelby wants to find the truth about her dad's online relationship with a woman he's never met. Dad David says "Maria" has a $10 million inheritance and says he knows for a fact that "Maria" is a real person and he can't wait to introduce her one day.
programme.sub-title: My Dad Believes He's Married To A Woman Named "Maria" He's Never Met Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: A Questionable Will & A Suspect Twin: Is This The Craziest Catfish Story Of Them All Pt. 2

programme.desc: Stacey & Dan say daughter Tylor, 18, is a rageaholic who is verbally, mentally & physically abusive. They have called the police 30 times, have had Tylor arrested 10 times & now Tylor is 7 weeks pregnant! Can this family join forces for the unborn child?
programme.sub-title: Our Pregnant, Rageaholic, 18-Year-Old Daughter Is Abusing Our Entire Family!
